issue-4610: reportRepo.create fails with "date/time field value out of range"
Opened by integrations-team-dk on 2026-11-05

Our script creates one report per client per month through
`POST /api/v1/reports`. A bug on our side made it ask for February 2027 with
`"to": "2027-02-29"`, and the API answer

args.title: Handle date/time field value out of range error in report creation
args.body:
File: src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts

Ensure that the date fields are validated before being sent to the database. Currently, invalid date values such as "2027-02-29" result in a 500 internal error. Instead, these should return a 400 error with a clear message indicating the problem with the date field.
